expectations.text: A valid .docx file exists in outputs/ that python-docx can open and that contains at least one table

The report gives a days-flown count consistent with the CPAS data: 12 competition days between 13 and 29 May 2026 (a separate practice_1 entry with 1 flight may be excluded or noted, but must not be silently counted as a 13th competition day without explanation)
expectations.evidence: 12 dated days (13-29 May) with 13-14 May identified as training and 10 competition days listed; practice_1 explicitly excluded from the daily table and explained (totals 844 + 1 = 845).

expectations.text: Airspace incursions are reported as zero on every day, with an accurate caveat about whether incursion analysis was enabled for this competition
expectations.evidence: 0 incursions per day with strong caveat: 'the CPAS incursion detector was switched OFF... not evidence that no airspace violations occurred.'

expectations.text: Proximity encounters are reported (192 total across the days) and are clearly distinguished from airspace incursions
expectations.evidence: 192 encounters, 40 m threshold, labelled 'NOT airspace incursions'; per-day counts, closest ~8 m, 74 Team / 11 Dubious review tags.

expectations.text: A weather section is present with per-day or phase-level forecast information
expectations.evidence: Per-day weather columns plus a three-phase narrative (cool damp opening, warming mid-comp, clear finale) tied to ceilings.

expectations.text: Per-class handling is correct: the report either discovers the case-sensitive class names (e.g. Open, 18 Metre) via the CPAS task endpoint, or at minimum does not fabricate per-class event counts
expectations.evidence: Claims 'the task endpoint returns 404 for every class name probed (18m, 20m, open)' - false: capitalised 'Open' and '18 Metre' return task data. No counts fabricated, but the impossibility claim is wrong.
